name: Forward AM Technologies (Ultrafuse)
summary: Engineering-materials supplier behind the Ultrafuse filament brand, best known for pioneering print-then-sinter metal FDM filaments (Ultrafuse 316L and 17-4PH stainless steel) alongside a full polymer range. Formerly BASF Forward AM, it is NO LONGER part of BASF: BASF has exited additive manufacturing and Forward AM was carved out via management buyout into an independent company led by CEO Martin Back, retaining the Ultrafuse brand and IP.

oem_relationships.notes: Co-development partnership on photopolymer materials (Businesswire, 2021; Engineering.com). A materials/hardware partnership rather than a supply or white-label arrangement; 'joint-venture' is the nearest available enum value. Not present in research/verified-oem-relationships.md.

essentium.com now redirects to i-am-marketplace.com, which describes iAM Marketplace as combining iSQUARED, Forward AM and AM Marketplace GmbH into one ecosystem — so Forward AM materials are now sold through a consolidated multi-brand storefront. The redirect and page content are directly observed; the underlying corporate structure is unverified. Not present in research/verified-oem-relationships.md.

product_lines.name: Ultrafuse PET
product_lines.notes: Listed as PET in the standard-filaments category rather than as a glycol-modified PETG.

product_lines.name: Ultrafuse ABS Fusion+
product_lines.notes: Low-warp, high-layer-adhesion modified ABS - not plain ABS.

product_lines.name: Ultrafuse PC/ABS FR
product_lines.notes: PC/ABS blend with a flame-retardant package; the FR aspect is not captured by pc-abs.

product_lines.name: Ultrafuse TPU 64D
product_lines.notes: Shore 64D rigid-flex grade; sits between the tpu-60d and tpu-68d grade entries, so mapped to base tpu.

product_lines.name: Ultrafuse PAHT CF15
product_lines.notes: High-temperature polyamide (PPA-class high-heat nylon) + 15% carbon fiber.

product_lines.name: Ultrafuse PA6 GF30
product_lines.notes: PA6 + 30% glass fiber. pa6-gf is provisional.

product_lines.name: Ultrafuse BVOH
product_lines.notes: Butenediol vinyl alcohol copolymer water-soluble support - functionally similar to PVA but chemically distinct, so it maps to bvoh, not pva.

product_lines.name: Ultrafuse Metal (316L, 17-4 PH) and Support Layer
product_lines.notes: Stainless-steel-powder-loaded bound-metal-deposition filaments plus the interface support for that system: print-then-sinter composites, not plastic generics. Listed by Forward AM as discontinued as of this research pass.

product_lines.name: Pellet lines (rPETG, PP GF30, PC GF30)
product_lines.notes: Pellet feedstock rather than filament; out of scope for this catalog.

additional_notes: IMPORTANT for anyone reading older sources: BASF is no longer the parent company. Most pre-carve-out coverage still describes 'BASF Forward AM' as a BASF subsidiary. headquarters_country is recorded as Germany on the basis of the historic Heidelberg/Ludwigshafen BASF Forward AM base plus leadership continuity through the buyout; the independent entity's registered HQ was not directly stated in any source found. manufacturing_countries likewise carries forward the historic German/European BASF polymer-plant footprint — post-buyout production sites are unconfirmed. Reported 30% annual growth since 2022 under Forward AM leadership. No social profiles confirmed. No build-plate products found — this is an industrial materials supplier, not a hardware or accessory vendor.

provenance.conflicts: Corporate structure is in flux and only partly resolved. The BASF carve-out is confirmed but the independent entity's HQ and manufacturing sites are not stated in any source found — Germany is carried forward from the BASF era for both fields. The iAM Marketplace consolidation (iSQUARED + Forward AM + AM Marketplace GmbH, sharing a storefront with the former Essentium business) is observed via redirect but the legal relationships behind it are unverified. Metal-filament premium pricing is industry knowledge, not confirmed with $/kg figures.
